idea-plugin.name: PASTA AI
idea-plugin.description:
PASTA is a JetBrains plugin for LLM-guided code modification within the IDE. Powered by GPT-4o, it is designed for research on prompting strategies in AI-assisted coding. This project is open source and available on GitHub.
The plugin supports two prompting workflows:
  • Summary-Mediated Prompting: Generate a natural language summary of selected code, edit the summary to describe desired changes, and submit it to the LLM. Includes a visual diff of summary edits.
  • Direct Instruction Prompting: Write free-form prompts directly to modify selected code. Changes are submitted along with code context and displayed as a side-by-side diff.
⚠️ Requires Local OS Environment OpenAI API: This plugin does not provide LLM inference. You must set up your own OpenAI API key as a local environment variable.
